newsitem.title: USA: Irwin raises $43.75 mln in securities.
newsitem.headline: Irwin raises $43.75 mln in securities.

text.p: Irwin Financial Corp said Tuesday it raised $43.75 million of capital through the issuance of 1,750,000 trust preferred securities.
The new securities have been approved for trading on The Nasdaq National Market under the symbol IRWNP.
Proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes and will strengthen the corporation's Tier 1 capital -- or core capital -- base.
The transaction involved the creation of preferred securities and the simultaneous issuing of a like amount of subordinated debt.

The trust preferred securities were issued at $25 a share and at a cumulative distribution rate of 9.25 percent, payable quarterly. The securities and the subordinated debt both have an initial maturity of 30 years with a 19-year extension option, which Irwin can exercise during the first 30 years.

The trust preferred securities are callable at par after five years, or immediately in the event of an adverse tax development affecting the corporation's classification of the debt for federal income tax purposes. The trust preferred securities are not convertible into common stock.

Stifel, Nicolaus & Co was the managing underwriter for the offering and has indicated it will make a market in the trust preferred securities, Irwin said. The underwriters have been granted an option to purchase up to 250,000 additional securities on the same terms as the base amount.

Irwin, through its four principal operating subsidiaries -- Inland Mortgage Corp, Irwin Union Bank and Trust Co, Irwin Home Equity Corp and Affiliated Capital Corp -- provides mortgage, commercial, and retail banking services.
